moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-char-exit-up, written here): Lines masked (mask 1.24 em tall). Each char y 0 → −100 % (one mask height) and opacity 1 → 0, 0.5 s easeInCubic (CSS cubic-bezier(.55,.055,.675,.19); recipe labels it power3.in), stagger 14 ms (demo 40 ms capped 0.5 s), from 0.8 s. Demo loop: chars come back up from below at 1.75 s (y +100 % → 0, 0.6 s expo.out, same stagger); loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.5 s) · stagger (0.014 s) · y: quãng ra (−100 %) · ease (easeInCubic).
